beats.summary: Mr. Brown tries to get Michael to sign a diversity seminar pledge, but Michael resists and mocks the process.

evidence.snippet: Michael (Clears throat): I don't think I can sign this.
Mr. Brown: I can't leave until you do.

beats.summary: Michael reads aloud a sarcastic version of the diversity pledge, signing it as 'Daffy Duck'.

evidence.snippet: Michael: "I regret my actions. I regret offending my coworkers. I pledge to bring my best spirit of honesty, empathy, respect and open-mindedness…"
